Bases: object

CBuild(x, y, w)[source]¶

Builds choosing statement for Gambler

Parameters:

  • x (int) – The amount of cure pills that would be in the bottle

  • y (int) – The total amount of pills in pill bottle

  • w (int) – The intermediate health state (health state being evaluated against the Gamble)

Returns:

Statement with health state

SBuild(x, y)[source]¶

Replaces text with health state for Scenario Statement

Parameters:

  • x (str) – The Health state

  • y (int) – The health state order as it appears on administration page

Returns:

Statement with health state

load(titleid, x=None)[source]¶

Load information for Standard Gamble page

Parameters:

  • titleid (str) – The titleid (foldername) of the Gambler project

  • Scenario_Statement (str) – The scenario statement that includes the second health state as ordered in the admin page

  • Scenario_Statement3 (str) – The scenario statement that includes the third health state as ordered in the admin page

  • Scenario_Statement4 (str) – The scenario statement that includes the fourth health state as ordered in the admin page

  • Scenario_Statement5 (str) – The scenario statement that includes the fifth health state as ordered in the admin page

  • Scenario_Statement6 (str) – The scenario statement that includes the sixth health state as ordered in the admin page

  • Scenario_Statement7 (str) – The scenario statement that includes the seventh health state as ordered in the admin page

  • Choosing_Statement (str) – This statement explains to users to make the choices in the Gambler health state

  • Benefits_Statement – This statement explains part of the Gamble that’s beneficial to users

  • Sideeffects_Statement – This statement explains the negative effects of taking the Gamble to users

  • Agreement_Statement_A (str) – Left side button normally used to choose the health state

  • Agreement_Statement_E (str) – Middle button normally to end the Gamble

  • Agreement_Statement_B (str) – Right side button normally used to choose The Gamble

  • Welcome_Statement (str) – The introduction statement used to welcome patients to the Standard Gamble screen

Returns:

Loaded information to self
